build_detection_train_loader: build a dataloader for object detection training with configurable mapper, sampler, and batch size
build_detection_test_loader: build a dataloader for object detection inference with batch size 1 and InferenceSampler
get_detection_dataset_dicts: load and prepare dataset dicts for detection with optional filtering and proposal loading
load_proposals_into_dataset: load precomputed object proposals from a pickle file into dataset dicts
print_instances_class_histogram: print a histogram showing the distribution of instances across all categories
